tokoh_utama: A 23-year-old Indonesian man with short messy black hair, wearing a dark green windbreaker jacket and jeans, riding a grey automatic scooter.

part.pertanyaan: Kalian pernah dikasih jalan aneh sama Google Maps? Cerita dong.
part.caption: Jangan pernah percaya 100% sama rute pintas Google Maps di kampung... #ceritahoror #urbanlegend

adegan.narasi: Google Maps menyuruhku belok ke jalan yang belum pernah ada di kampungku.
adegan.gambar: Close-up on smartphone mounted on scooter handlebar showing a dark navigation map, pointing toward a pitch black alley.

adegan.narasi: Padahal aku sudah paham betul setiap sudut jalanan kampung ini dari kecil.
adegan.gambar: A 23-year-old Indonesian man riding a grey scooter, looking confused at a narrow paved entrance lit by dim yellow streetlights.

adegan.narasi: Aplikasi di ponsel bilang ada jalan pintas sepuluh menit lebih cepat.
adegan.gambar: POV looking at smartphone screen displaying a bright blue GPS route cutting through an unmarked black area.

adegan.narasi: Jalannya beraspal sangat mulus tanpa ada lubang sama sekali di sepanjang jalan.
adegan.gambar: Wide shot of a clean, perfectly smooth black asphalt road stretching into darkness with warm yellow streetlights casting long shadows.

adegan.narasi: Lampu-lampu jalan memancarkan cahaya kuning redup memanjang ke depan lorong.
adegan.gambar: Low angle view of eerie dim yellow streetlights along an empty, quiet Indonesian village road at night.

adegan.narasi: Rumah-rumah di pinggir jalan bermodel tua, tapi semua lampunya menyala terang.
adegan.gambar: Row of traditional Javanese wooden houses with bright glowing porch lights, standing unnaturally quiet along the road.

adegan.narasi: Aku memperlambat laju motor karena merasa ada yang aneh di sini.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the protagonist's anxious face under helmet visor, glancing left and right suspiciously.

adegan.narasi: Suara mesin motorku terdengar sangat nyaring di tengah keheningan malam ini.
adegan.gambar: Side view of grey scooter slowly cruising down the empty street under glowing yellow lamps.

adegan.narasi: Aku sempat melirik gantungan kunci di motorku, pemberian sahabat lama.
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up on the scooter key ignition featuring a distinct blue acrylic helmet keychain with a cartoon sticker.

adegan.narasi: Di teras rumah-rumah kayu itu, tampak beberapa warga sedang duduk santai.
adegan.gambar: A group of pale figures sitting still on a wooden house porch; notably, one figure wearing a batik shirt has a completely smooth face with no eyes, nose, or mouth.

adegan.narasi: Tiba-tiba bulu kudukku berdiri saat melihat ke arah teras-teras rumah itu.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of goosebumps rising on the protagonist's forearm skin under his green jacket sleeve.

adegan.narasi: Di semua teras rumah, orang-orang duduk diam dan menoleh bersamaan menatapku!
adegan.gambar: Terrifying wide shot of dozens of shadowy villagers on every porch suddenly snapping their heads sideways in unison to glare directly at the camera.

part.pertanyaan: Kalau ditanya 'mau menetap atau cuma lewat', kamu jawab apa?
part.caption: Jangan sembarangan mampir ke warung kalau GPS bilang 'Anda telah sampai'... #ceritahoror #part2

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan... aku makin panik dan memacu motor kencang-kencang menembus kegelapan malam.
adegan.gambar: The protagonist speeding frantically on his grey scooter through the eerie dark village street.

adegan.narasi: Aplikasi di ponsel mengeluarkan suara, 'Anda telah sampai' tepat di warung.
adegan.gambar: Phone screen showing destination pin right in front of a rustic wooden food stall with glowing warm lights.

adegan.narasi: Sebuah warung kayu berdiri di pinggir jalan dengan lampu neon redup.
adegan.gambar: Medium shot of an old traditional Javanese wooden food stall standing alone in dark surroundings with a buzzing flickering neon light.

adegan.narasi: Penjualnya seorang kakek tua yang tersenyum ramah dari balik meja kayu.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of an elderly Indonesian man behind a wooden counter, wearing a sarong and black cap, smiling unnaturally wide.

adegan.narasi: Kakek itu langsung menyuguhkan segelas teh hangat manis beruap tebal padaku.
adegan.gambar: An old wrinkled hand placing a glass of steaming hot dark amber tea onto a worn wooden table.

adegan.narasi: Aku duduk kaku sambil menggenggam stang motorku yang terasa dingin sekali.
adegan.gambar: Protagonist sitting uncomfortably on a wooden bench, hands trembling while looking at the glass of tea.

adegan.narasi: Penjual itu menatapku erat lalu bertanya, "Mau menetap atau cuma lewat?"
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the old warung seller leaning forward, eyes wide and unblinking under dim light.

adegan.narasi: Pertanyaan singkat itu membuat dadaku berdebar kencang dan merinding ketakutan.
adegan.gambar: Close-up on protagonist's terrified eyes, sweat dripping down his cheek in the yellow lighting.

adegan.narasi: Pandanganku beralih ke dinding kayu warung yang dipenuhi foto-foto tua berkaca.
adegan.gambar: A wooden wall filled with old framed black-and-white photos of motorcyclists; in the reflection of the glass, a dark headless shadow stands right behind the protagonist.

adegan.narasi: Foto-foto itu memperlihatkan para pengendara motor yang tersenyum pucat dan kaku.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of multiple framed photos on wall showing smiling motorcyclists posing with their bikes, all with eerie rigid smiles.

adegan.narasi: Jantungku serasa berhenti saat mataku menangkap satu foto di sudut atas.
adegan.gambar: Protagonist pointing in shock toward a specific photo framed near the upper corner of the wooden wall.

adegan.narasi: Di foto itu terlihat jelas kawan SMA-ku yang hilang misterius tahun lalu!
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up on a framed photo showing a young man holding the exact same blue acrylic helmet keychain, smiling stiffly beside his motorcycle.

part.pertanyaan: Kalau Google Maps kamu mendadak muncul notifikasi kayak gini, kamu ngapain?
part.caption: Jangan pernah terima tawaran minuman di jalan yang tak dikenal... #ceritahoror #part3 #ending

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan... aku menolak teh hangat itu dan menjawab, "Cuma lewat, Mbah."
adegan.gambar: Protagonist quickly pushing the glass of tea away and backing up toward his scooter.

adegan.narasi: Seketika itu juga seluruh lampu warung padam total dan kegelapan mencekam datang.
adegan.gambar: Complete pitch black view as neon lights flicker violently and shut off instantly.

adegan.narasi: Angin dingin berembus kencang diiringi bau tanah wetan yang sangat menyengat.
adegan.gambar: Leaves blowing wildly through pitch black dark air, fog rolling along the ground.

adegan.narasi: Saat membuka mata, aku sudah berdiri gemetar di tengah kebun bambu.
adegan.gambar: Protagonist standing terrified surrounded by dense, tall bamboo stalks under faint moonlight.

adegan.narasi: Motorku tergeletak di atas tanah becek yang dipenuhi rumput liar tinggi.
adegan.gambar: The grey automatic scooter lying sideways on muddy wet dirt among wild bamboo shoots.

adegan.narasi: Batang-batang bambu bergesekan nyaring seolah-olah ada sosok tinggi yang mengawasi.
adegan.gambar: Dense dark bamboo forest at night; deep between the bamboo leaves, two glowing pale eyes and a white face peek out silently.

adegan.narasi: Tanpa berpikir panjang, aku menegakkan motor dan langsung kabur sekuat tenaga.
adegan.gambar: Protagonist frantically lifting his grey scooter up and kick-starting the engine in terror.

adegan.narasi: Aku akhirnya berhasil menembus kegelapan dan sampai di jalan raya utama.
adegan.gambar: Scooter bursting out from dark woods onto a paved public street lit by bright white modern city streetlights.

adegan.narasi: Kejadian mengerikan itu membuatku shock berat dan trauma melewati jalan pintas.
adegan.gambar: Protagonist sitting on bedroom bed late at night, hugging knees while staring blankly at the wall.

adegan.narasi: Namun teror sebenarnya baru dimulai setiap kali aku membuka aplikasi peta.
adegan.gambar: Close-up on a hand holding a glowing smartphone on a nightstand in a dark room.

adegan.narasi: Rute jalan pintas misterius itu kini selalu muncul paling atas di layar.
adegan.gambar: POV of smartphone map UI showing a top suggested route highlighted in red glowing line labeled 'Pintas Khusus'.

adegan.narasi: Peta itu menampilkan rute merah dengan keterangan, 'Teman Anda sedang menunggu.'
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up on smartphone screen displaying navigation notification box text reading 'Teman Anda sedang menunggu' with a small avatar of the missing friend.
